summary_en: Annual dividend for fiscal year ending January 2027 raised to 55 yen per share from 45 yen, with interim dividend increased 5 yen to 25 yen and year-end dividend increased 5 yen to 30 yen, reflecting upward revision of earnings guidance and balanced approach between shareholder returns and growth investment.
title_en: Notification of Revision to Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase)
translation_en_brief:
Arr Planner revised its dividend forecast for the fiscal year ending January 2027 on 10 September 2026. The annual dividend per share was increased to 55 yen from the previously forecast 45 yen. This consists of an interim dividend of 25 yen (raised by 5 yen) and a year-end dividend of 30 yen (raised by 5 yen). The company noted that a 2-for-1 stock split was executed on 1 February 2026, and the stated dividend amounts reflect post-split figures.

The revision reflects the company's basic policy of balancing stable dividend payments with growth investments to maximize long-term corporate value for shareholders. The increase was decided in light of upward revisions to consolidated earnings forecasts for the second quarter and full year of fiscal 2027, which were announced on the same date. The company maintains its commitment to consistent dividend distributions while ensuring adequate resources for capital investment.
